commands: sudo k3s kubectl -n phantom-eval exec deploy/recommendationservice -- python -c "import os,time; print('PHANTOM_HARMLESS_PROCESS_PID='+str(os.getpid()),flush=True); time.sleep(5)"

sudo k3s kubectl -n phantom exec deploy/phantom-postgres -- psql -U phantom -d phantom -Atc "SELECT event_id, observed_at, event_type, comm, executable_path, image_digest, binding_status FROM drift_events WHERE observed_at > now() - interval '1 minute' AND namespace = 'phantom-eval' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 12"
sudo k3s kubectl -n phantom logs daemonset/phantom-ebpf-agent --since=25s --tail=400 2>&1 | grep -E 'dispatcher.success|comm=python' | tail -20
sudo k3s kubectl -n phantom get pod -l app=phantom-ebpf-agent -o jsonpath="{.items[0].status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}"; echo
